_notes: Copy this file to llm.config.json at the repo root (git-ignored). The API key is read from the env var named by apiKeyEnv and NEVER ships to the browser -- export it in the shell that runs the dev server (e.g. $env:OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-..."). To use Anthropic instead, set provider to "anthropic" and endpoint to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages. Per-operation overrides key by operation name: { "<operation>": { "model": "...", "temperature": 0.1, "maxTokens": 4000 } }.
